The source plugin is the only source of every target package; no target package is maintained by hand
Generated files are written outside `plugins/architect/agents/` and `plugins/architect/scripts/`
A target is released only when its write/shell boundary is enforced by an enforcement mechanism; a boundary that relies on agent instructions alone is never released
The sdd MCP server is a stdio process that the host starts with a session and stops with it; it is not a daemon and opens no network connection
Requirements that change CHG-001 behaviour are `MODIFIED` deltas citing the C001 requirement; their LINT-DELTA-001 findings are waived at G2 and G3 until C001-T-075 archives CHG-001

The path and bash guard cores are the only decision point for the write/shell boundary of the sdd MCP server, of the Copilot hooks fallback and of the Claude Code hooks; no mechanism re-implements their rules (the Serena-command confinement of C002-IF-008 §1.1 included), and the OpenCode permission rules are generated from the same allowlist with no `allow` rule wider than a guard entry (C002-IF-001 §6.3)
The sdd MCP server runs commands without a shell: it executes the words the bash guard core tokenised, applies the pipe-only entries in-process and does not run `.cmd` or `.bat` files
Every fault in the sdd MCP server or in an agent-scoped guard hook ends in a refusal: an error result that changed nothing, or exit code 2; no error path allows a call
Generation is deterministic: sorted traversal, LF line endings, UTF-8 without BOM, stable JSON key order, and no time stamp or machine path in any generated file
Mapping tables and wiring variants live in `plugins/architect/targets/`; no Claude Code agent preloads them, and the Claude Code staging of `npm run package` leaves the folder out
`architect-sdd` has no runtime dependency and no install script; its two entries bundle every package they import except Node.js built-ins

Review of C001-CON-02 (one bundled file): the plugin keeps exactly one bundled file, `scripts/sdd.mjs`; `architect-sdd` carries two bundled entries (`sdd`, `sdd-mcp`); the Copilot target package carries a byte copy of the plugin's bundle for its hook commands. C001-CON-02 stays in force for the plugin

Review of C001-CON-03 (distribution as a Claude Code plugin): Claude Code stays the source target, distributed as today; the generated target packages and `architect-sdd` are additional distributions written by the same `npm run package`

Copilot hook commands call the CLI copy inside the Copilot target package (`node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sdd.mjs" …`), never a PATH lookup, so that a missing Node.js is the only start failure left to a guard hook
One sdd MCP server process serves one repository, fixed at initialisation; writes to any other `.sdd/` folder, including those of the other folders of a multi-root VS Code workspace, are refused
One version per packaging run: the source plugin version is the version of both target packages and of `architect-sdd`
Every scenario of C002-CAP-01's `acceptance.md` passes in the integration suite on REF-WIN; `@eval` scenarios pass in at least 9 of 10 runs on OpenCode at its tested version

Every scenario of C002-CAP-02's `acceptance.md` passes: untagged and `@mode-*` scenarios in the integration suite against OpenCode at its tested version, `@eval` scenarios in at least 9 of 10 runs on OpenCode and on Claude Code, `@manual-vscode` scenarios through C002-DOD-004

Every scenario of C002-CAP-03's `acceptance.md` passes: untagged and `@mode-*` scenarios in the integration suite, `@eval` scenarios in at least 9 of 10 runs through the Copilot CLI eval runner or the OpenCode eval runner, `@manual-vscode` scenarios through C002-DOD-004

A checklist record of one run of the manual VS Code checklist, made on the tested VS Code and GitHub Copilot Chat versions, shows every step passed, including one step for each `@manual-vscode` scenario of C002-CAP-02, C002-CAP-03 and C002-CAP-05, a toy change taken from its creation to gate G1 on a fresh install, a Revise choice at gate G1 followed by the gate presented again, and one run of the revise prompt on the toy change's approved ideation phase; under the Copilot hooks fallback the record also states hooks "enabled" during the run and holds one passed step for each Copilot injection case
Every scenario of C002-CAP-04's `acceptance.md` passes in the integration suite on REF-WIN, with the sdd MCP server started from the packed `architect-sdd` tarball

Every scenario of C002-CAP-05's `acceptance.md` passes: npm and allowlist scenarios in the integration suite, `@eval` doctor scenarios in at least 9 of 10 runs on Claude Code and on OpenCode, and for the Copilot target package through the Copilot CLI eval runner, `@manual-vscode` scenarios through C002-DOD-004

Every scenario of C002-CAP-06's `acceptance.md` passes: untagged scenarios in the integration suite, `@eval` scenarios at the dev tier in at least 9 of 10 runs, `@review` scenarios with a review entry in the test report naming the reviewer and the reviewed file

For each enforcement mechanism in use on a generated target, under PowerShell 7 and Git Bash, with each host at its tested version, the corpus replay suite reports 0 differing decisions (0 false allows, 0 false denies) over the applicable cases of the path corpus and of the shell corpus, against the expected decision for that mechanism (memory-category cases `deny`, C002-REQ-625), and its replay report lists every case not replayed by ID as not applicable (identity-category cases on the sdd MCP server and the agent-scoped guard hooks only, C002-REQ-626, C002-REQ-627)

The injection evals report 0 instructions acted upon over at least 20 injection cases per generated target at the dev tier, on the hosts' tested versions and the Claude model tiers of C002-REQ-105; under the Copilot hooks fallback the Copilot cases counted are those of the checklist record of C002-DOD-004, run in VS Code with hooks "enabled", and Copilot CLI results do not count towards the 20

The benchmark scripts under `bench/` record on REF-WIN: sdd MCP server refusals at p95 ≤ 300 ms over 50 calls; writes with quick-lint findings at p95 ≤ 800 ms over 20 calls; generation of both target packages at p95 ≤ 5 s over 10 runs
The target structure check on both target packages reports no inlining-budget error: every inlined skill ≤ 24,000 characters and every generated agent's inlined skills ≤ 64,000 characters

The runner tests with a stub host end every session at 30 turns or at 0.50 USD for both eval runners, and the dev-tier eval results record a spend of at most 0.50 USD per session wherever the host reports spend

The fault-injection tests allow 0 calls with each fault class (malformed input, unknown tool name, exception in a guard core, I/O error) injected into each write and command tool of the sdd MCP server and into each agent-scoped guard hook
The sdd MCP server tests run with `tests/no-network.mjs` preloaded and record 0 outbound connections
The determinism test generates both target packages twice into separate folders and finds 0 differing bytes and 0 differing file names, under PowerShell 7 and under Git Bash

The install smoke test of the packed `architect-sdd` tarball (global install into a clean prefix, `sdd status` in a fixture workspace, MCP initialisation exchange with the sdd MCP server) passes in all 4 combinations of PowerShell 7 or Git Bash with Node.js 20 LTS or 22 LTS

The manifest check on the packed tarball finds 0 `dependencies` entries and 0 runtime imports outside bundled code and Node.js built-ins, and both entries run from an install folder that holds no other package
For each target package proposed for release, the release check's regeneration at the release commit finds 0 files missing, extra or different
A timed clean-profile run per generated target, following that package's install notes, reaches the first interview question of a new change in ≤ 15 minutes, download time excluded

The build license check passes for both `architect-sdd` entries and an SPDX header scan of `dist/opencode/`, `dist/copilot/` and the tarball finds 0 files or bundled packages outside the license allowlist
A fresh OpenCode install on REF-WIN takes a toy change from its creation to gate G1 with the generated OpenCode target package; the session transcript and the change's Gate log row are linked

The regression set (`20-plan/30-impact/regression-set.md`) passes on the implementation of CHG-002, with the corpus cases and deny-message texts changed by C002-REQ-503 and C002-REQ-517 as the only changed expectations, and the Serena step of the Claude Code doctor and init commands allowed by the bash guard
`sdd defect` output shows defect D-011 of CHG-001 closed after the task implementing C002-REQ-503 is done

A question-tool result without a choice of P-01 creates no answer in a questions log and no gate approval.

A release record with outcome `released` cites, at the tested versions, a corpus replay with 0 differing decisions over the applicable cases for every mechanism of the package's mode and an injection summary with no case acted upon; for Copilot VS Code also a checklist record with every step passed; and under the Copilot hooks fallback a checklist record with hooks enabled whose injection steps are the injection evidence, and the exception of C002-DEC-005.
In one packaging run, the source plugin version, the `package_version` of both target packages and the version of `architect-sdd` are equal.
No Claude Code construct reaches a target package untranslated outside the contexts its detector accepts; a run that cannot translate one fails.

A replay report lists every case of the corpora it cites exactly once: replayed with the expected decision of its mechanism, or not applicable by C002-REQ-626 (identity-category cases on the sdd MCP server and the agent-scoped guard hooks only).
